description: Versioned manifest of regulatory documents used by the HERA Copilot for RAG (Task #7) and decision-tree cartographie (Task #12). All entries are public documents. Paywalled standards (ISO) are referenced but not downloaded.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 — Artificial Intelligence Act
documents.license: Public domain (Official Journal of the EU)
documents.notes: Cite Annex III §1(a) for healthcare AI high-risk classification.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2017/745 — Medical Device Regulation (MDR)
documents.license: Public domain (Official Journal of the EU)
documents.notes: Rule 11 (Annex VIII) is the load-bearing rule for SaMD classification.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 — General Data Protection Regulation
documents.license: Public domain (Official Journal of the EU)
documents.notes: Art. 9 special-category data is the entry point for any health app.

documents.title: MDCG 2019-11 — Guidance on Qualification and Classification of Software in Regulation (EU) 2017/745 — MDR
documents.publisher: European Commission, Medical Device Coordination Group
documents.license: European Commission documents — free use with attribution
documents.notes: The decision tree in this document is closely related to our cartographie deliverable.

documents.title: ISO/TS 82304-2:2021 — Health software — Part 2: Health and wellness apps — Quality and reliability
documents.notes: Referenced via summaries in MDCG / NICE rather than primary text.

documents.title: Evidence Standards Framework for Digital Health Technologies
documents.notes: Manual download needed — visit the URL, click 'Download document'.

documents.title: Digital Technology Assessment Criteria (DTAC)
documents.notes: Manual download — there's a PDF + Excel checklist.

documents.title: Ethics and governance of artificial intelligence for health — Guidance on large multi-modal models
documents.notes: Direct download link on IRIS landing page.

documents.title: Verordnung über Medizinprodukte (MepV) / Ordonnance sur les dispositifs médicaux (ODim) — SR 812.213
documents.notes: Largely mirrors MDR EU; Swiss-specific differences in Annex 4.

documents.title: Bundesgesetz über den Datenschutz / Loi sur la protection des données (LPD/nLPD) — SR 235.1
documents.notes: nLPD = nouvelle Loi sur la Protection des Données, in force since 2023-09.

documents.title: Bundesgesetz über das elektronische Patientendossier (EPDG) / Loi sur le dossier électronique du patient (LDEP) — SR 816.1
documents.notes: Required if your app integrates with DEP.

documents.title: Schweizerischer Impfplan / Plan suisse de vaccination
EDPB Guidelines 3/2019 on processing of personal data through video devices + Guidelines on processing health data
key_articles: Special category data processing under Art. 9(2)
documents.notes: Landing page lists all relevant guidelines — pick the latest health-data set.

documents.title: Principles of Biomedical Ethics, 8th ed.
documents.authors: Tom L. Beauchamp & James F. Childress
documents.license: Copyrighted book — cited only, not stored in RAG
key_articles: Four principles: Autonomy, Beneficence, Non-maleficence, Justice
documents.notes: Used for foundational principles in Pillar 3 (Autonomy) and Pillar 6 (Justice).
